objective: Implementar D2.1 de forma quirurgica y fail-closed: introducir un clasificador canonico comun para distinguir suciedad real del worktree frente a artefactos runtime recovery untracked estrictamente tipados y validados. Staged, tracked modified, untracked desconocido, symlink, JSON invalido, schema no permitido, campos inesperados, production_touched distinto de false o target_queue_branch no canonico deben seguir bloqueando. Integrar el mismo clasificador en wake, shared_app_safety_guard, bootstrap watchdog, worker control plane y git divergence guard. No modificar .gitignore, no migrar staging, no borrar triggers, no stash, no git clean, no ampliar Production y no tocar SQL/RBAC/Scheduler/NetPay.

import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
GUARD = ROOT / "tools" / "mirror_sync" / "runtime_worktree_guard.py"


def load_guard():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("runtime_worktree_guard_d2", GUARD)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=repo,
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout
    return result.stdout.strip()


def repo(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    work = tmp_path / "repo"
    work.mkdir()
    git(work, "init")
    git(work, "config", "user.email", "d2@example.com")
    git(work, "config", "user.name", "D2")
    (work / "seed.txt").write_text("seed\n", encoding="utf-8")
    git(work, "add", "seed.txt")
    git(work, "commit", "-m", "seed")
    return work


def valid_trigger(work: Path, name: str = "wake.json") -> Path:
    target = work / "worker_queue" / "triggers" / "runtime-recovery" / name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-recovery-trigger.v1",
                "reason": "Wake existing canonical worker only.",
                "production_touched": False,
            }
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return target


def test_validated_runtime_artifact_does_not_count_as_real_dirty(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()
    work = repo(tmp_path)
    target = valid_trigger(work)
    state = module.classify_worktree(work)
    assert state["real_dirty"] is False
    assert state["validated_runtime_artifacts"] == [
        str(target.relative_to(work))
    ]
    assert state["unsafe_untracked"] == []


def test_random_untracked_still_blocks(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()
    work = repo(tmp_path)
    (work / "random.txt").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
    state = module.classify_worktree(work)
    assert state["real_dirty"] is True
    assert state["unsafe_untracked"][0]["path"] == "random.txt"


def test_valid_runtime_plus_random_untracked_blocks(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()
    work = repo(tmp_path)
    valid_trigger(work)
    (work / "random.txt").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
    state = module.classify_worktree(work)
    assert state["real_dirty"] is True
    assert state["validated_runtime_artifact_count"] == 1
    assert state["unsafe_untracked_count"] == 1


def test_tracked_modified_and_staged_always_block(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()
    work = repo(tmp_path)
    valid_trigger(work)
    (work / "seed.txt").write_text("changed\n", encoding="utf-8")
    state = module.classify_worktree(work)
    assert state["real_dirty"] is True
    assert state["unstaged_count"] == 1
    git(work, "add", "seed.txt")
    state = module.classify_worktree(work)
    assert state["real_dirty"] is True
    assert state["staged_count"] == 1


def test_symlink_in_allowlisted_path_blocks(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()
    work = repo(tmp_path)
    directory = work / "worker_queue" / "triggers" / "runtime-recovery"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    outside = work / "outside.json"
    outside.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    (directory / "wake.json").symlink_to(outside)
    state = module.classify_worktree(work)
    assert state["real_dirty"] is True
    assert state["unsafe_untracked"][0]["reason"] == "SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN"


def test_invalid_json_unknown_schema_and_production_true_block(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()

    work = repo(tmp_path / "a")
    target = valid_trigger(work)
    target.write_text("{", encoding="utf-8")
    assert module.classify_worktree(work)["unsafe_untracked"][0]["reason"] == "INVALID_JSON"

    work = repo(tmp_path / "b")
    target = valid_trigger(work)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": "unknown.v1",
                "reason": "x",
                "production_touched": False,
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert module.classify_worktree(work)["unsafe_untracked"][0]["reason"] == "SCHEMA_NOT_ALLOWLISTED"

    work = repo(tmp_path / "c")
    target = valid_trigger(work)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-recovery-trigger.v1",
                "reason": "x",
                "production_touched": True,
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert module.classify_worktree(work)["unsafe_untracked"][0]["reason"] == "PRODUCTION_TOUCHED_MUST_BE_FALSE"


def test_nested_runtime_path_and_unexpected_fields_block(tmp_path):
    module = load_guard()

    work = repo(tmp_path / "a")
    nested = work / "worker_queue" / "triggers" / "runtime-recovery" / "nested" / "wake.json"
    nested.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    nested.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-recovery-trigger.v1",
                "reason": "x",
                "production_touched": False,
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert module.classify_worktree(work)["unsafe_untracked"][0]["reason"] == "PATH_NOT_ALLOWLISTED"

    work = repo(tmp_path / "b")
    target = valid_trigger(work)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-recovery-trigger.v1",
                "reason": "x",
                "production_touched": False,
                "actions": [],
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert module.classify_worktree(work)["unsafe_untracked"][0]["reason"] == "UNEXPECTED_FIELDS"


def test_consumers_use_canonical_runtime_guard():
    consumers = [
        ROOT / "backend/modules/worker_runtime_wake/routes.py",
        ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/shared_app_safety_guard.sh",
        ROOT / "tools/bootstrap/edarsahub_bootstrap_watchdog.py",
        ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/worker_control_plane.py",
        ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/git_divergence_guard.py",
    ]
    for path in consumers:
        assert "runtime_worktree_guard.py" in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

def _status_counts(repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    guard = Path(__file__).with_name("runtime_worktree_guard.py")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(guard), "--repo", str(repo), "--json"],
        cwd=str(repo),
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise GitGuardError("GIT_WORKTREE_GUARD_FAILED", {"output": proc.stdout[-2000:]})
    try:
        state = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise GitGuardError("GIT_WORKTREE_GUARD_INVALID", {"output": proc.stdout[-2000:]}) from exc
    return {
        "worktree_dirty": bool(state.get("real_dirty")),
        "staged_count": int(state.get("staged_count") or 0),
        "unstaged_count": int(state.get("unstaged_count") or 0),
        "untracked_count": int(state.get("untracked_count") or 0),
        "validated_runtime_artifact_count": int(state.get("validated_runtime_artifact_count") or 0),
        "unsafe_untracked_count": int(state.get("unsafe_untracked_count") or 0),
        "validated_runtime_artifacts": list(state.get("validated_runtime_artifacts") or []),
        "unsafe_untracked": list(state.get("unsafe_untracked") or []),
    }
